record.name: São Tomé and Príncipe
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. UNESCO's 2026 readiness assessment records no national AI strategy, no AI-specific law and no AI governance body; the roadmap includes approving a law for an AI strategy.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. Recorded English and national or official-language queries and retrieved primary governance evidence support medium confidence. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

check.language_note: The recorded pt query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. Preserved result batches, using 1-based positions in check.searches: ST-search = searches 1, 2 (en, pt). Each multi-query batch has only a combined returned result set; its source_ids cannot be attributed to individual queries. Historical query dates are recorded as 17 October 2026 in the phase6 search-boundary ledger.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: UNESCO's completed national readiness assessment describes existing institutional anchors and the lack of a dedicated AI governance structure. This is contextual assessment, not a dated official institute-absence statement.

related_bodies.name: Institute for Innovation and Knowledge (INIC)
related_bodies.role: It can issue digital strategies and guidelines; it has limited capacity and no AI evaluation mandate.

related_bodies.name: National Agency for Personal Data Protection (ANPDP)
related_bodies.role: It is a data protection authority; it is named by UNESCO as a base for future AI governance.

record.notes:
Cited foreign sources for the governance context: UNESCO. UNESCO's assessment names the Institute for Innovation and Knowledge (INIC) and the data-protection agency as existing institutional anchors.

UNESCO's completed readiness profile and the INIC government catalogue refer to the same assessment. The catalogue does not provide independent corroboration, and no second independent substantive source was retrieved. Searches covered indexed public English and Portuguese sources for a government-designated AI safety institute with a remit to evaluate advanced models.

next_check.reason: Check whether the AI strategy law in UNESCO's roadmap is approved.
